trans_title: Creatures – An Adventure Between Two Worlds
introduction: Stela is a twelve-year-old girl and only believes in what she can see, or sometimes not even that. Miguel, her younger brother, believes in everything, especially in what doesn’t exist. Two years after the tragic dive that took their mother, they return to the mythical city of Paraty, where nothing is what it seems. Based on Maria Camargo’s book “Criaturas”.
